description: Calculate a person's Human Design chart from their birth date, birth time (optional) and the IANA time zone of their birthplace. Returns type, strategy, authority, profile, definition, defined and open centers, channels, approved plain-English texts for each, and a link to their chart card. If the birth time is unknown, the chart is calculated for every half hour of the day and the result says which parts depend on the time.

birth_time.description: Local birth time, 24-hour HH:MM. Leave out if unknown.

time_zone.description: IANA time zone of the birthplace, e.g. America/Chicago or Europe/London.

name: get_human_design_chart
title: Get Human Design chart
